_meta.description: Data contracts for every component in the Fiona app. Backend visualization[] items must match the schema for the given type. UI-only components (chat, layout) have no API contract.

FinanceBriefingSignals._description: Priority signal cards on the Ask page briefing header.

signals.title: string
signals.metric_text: string — key figure e.g. 1.8% vs 1.5% parameter

signalToChip.SIG-USSFCU-FIN-001: chip text fired when tile is clicked

FinanceKpiRow._description: KPI stat carousel — 4 tiles per page with pagination.

stats.icon: string — lucide icon name e.g. shield-alert (optional)
stats.label: string — short label e.g. Net Worth Ratio
stats.chipText: string — question sent to AI on click (optional)

PortfolioLimitChart._description: Horizontal bars showing each portfolio balance vs board risk-tolerance cap.

DelinquencyTrend._description: Multi-line chart of 60-day delinquency by loan segment over eight quarters.

ScenarioImpactTable._description: Member behaviour funnel bars and delinquency segment before/after table for a modeled scenario.
ScenarioImpactTable._validation: scenario.lossOverTwoQuarters must be a number AND scenario.delinquencyBySegment must be an array

CapitalLiquidityGauges._description: Three SVG semicircle gauges showing net worth ratio, liquidity surplus, and loan-to-share before/after a scenario, plus a reconciliation table.

PlaybookActionTable._description: Severity scale strip and board playbook action table, with the modeled scenario's band highlighted.

schema.playbookTitle: string — e.g. Board shutdown playbook · pre-set actions by severity

bands.band: string — severity tier e.g. Short shutdown

DataSourcesGrid._description: Grid of connected data source cards with status, freshness, and record count.

sources.name: string — display name
sources.icon: string — lucide icon name e.g. database (optional)
sources.lastSync: string — ISO date or relative e.g. 2026-11-02 (optional)

CurrentStateDiagram._description: Process flow diagram showing current-state steps with gap highlights and AI intervention callouts.

steps.label: string — step description
steps.detail: string — cycle time or next step (optional)

interventions.intervention: string — what the AI does instead

JourneyMap._description: Horizontal journey map with emotion scores, pain points, and AI opportunity callouts per phase.

ChatMessage._description: Single message bubble in the chat thread.

schema.inlineComponents: ReactNode[] — visualization components rendered below the message (optional)

ChatInput._description: Gradient-border text input with suggestions dropdown.

TypingIndicator._description: Animated three-dot typing indicator shown while AI is responding.

FinanceDataPosturePanel._description: Self-contained panel showing real public backdrop facts, illustrative data notice, CurrentStateDiagram, and JourneyMap. Reads from static constants.

ChatInterface._description: Wrapper component that owns all chat state (messages, typing, chips, greeting). Each persona's AskPage renders a thin wrapper passing persona config.

schema.greeting: string — persona first name shown in greeting header e.g. 'Fiona'
schema.briefingSlot: ReactNode — initial-view briefing content rendered above the AI Conversation divider (optional)
schema.inlineMap: Record<string, ReactNode[]> — visualization components keyed by message id (optional)

FollowUpChips._description: Small follow-up chip pills rendered above the chat input. Chips come from the API response suggested_chips only — no static fallback. The recommended chip is highlighted in brand color.

schema.recommendedChip: string | null — chip text to highlight as recommended (optional)
schema.onChipClick: function(chip: string) — called when a chip is clicked
schema.isPanel: boolean — enables scrollable max-height for panel contexts (optional)
schema.compactOnMobile: boolean — enables scrollable max-height on mobile only (optional)

SourceBadge._description: Inline badge pill showing a data source name with a color-coded dot. Known sources map to specific dot colors; unknown sources fall back to a neutral dot.

schema.source: string — data source display name e.g. 'Core Banking System' (optional)

PageError._description: Full-height centered error state with an alert icon, message text, and optional retry button.

schema.message: string — error description shown below the heading (optional, has default)
schema.onRetry: function() — called when the Retry button is clicked; hides the button when omitted (optional)

MaximizablePanel._description: Panel wrapper that can expand to a full-screen overlay via a MaximizeButton trigger. The original inline slot shows a placeholder while maximized. Closes on Escape or the close button. Exports MaximizeButton for use inside the panel header.

schema.className: string — additional classes applied to the inline and maximized panel shell (optional)
schema.children: ReactNode | ((state: { maximized: boolean }) => ReactNode) — panel content; function form receives maximized state (optional)
schema.label: string — human-readable panel name shown in the placeholder and aria-label (optional, default 'Panel')
schema.shell: string — Tailwind classes for the panel shell; overrides the default rounded-2xl border style (optional)

MessageFeedback._description: Thumbs-up / thumbs-down feedback widget rendered below each AI message. Positive feedback logs immediately; negative opens a comment modal. Result persists to sessionStorage keyed by messageId.

schema.messageId: string — unique id of the message this feedback belongs to
